Choose your own personal play-style from brute force and blazing guns to stalk-and-kill tactics as you use Lincoln's military training and gathered intel to tear down the Italian Mafia.

A NEW FAMILY ON THE ASHES OF THE OLD

Build a new criminal empire in your own unique way by deciding which of your lieutenants you reward and which you betray.

When does Stick Season 2 premiere?
Stick Season 2 premieres globally on Apple TV on November 4, 2026, with two episodes, followed by one episode every Wednesday through December 30. Season one premiered on June 4, 2025, and is now streaming.

Where can I watch Stick?
Watch Stick on Apple TV.

Who stars in Stick Season 2?
Owen Wilson, Peter Dager, Marc Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lilli Kay, Judy Greer and Timothy Olyphant return. Rhea Seehorn joins the cast as Amanda, Pryce’s new golf coach.

Who created Stick?
Stick is created and showrun by Jason Keller, who executive produces alongside Owen Wilson, Ben Silverman, Guymon Casady and others.

What is Stick Season 2 about?
As Santi navigates the pressures of pursuing professional golf, Pryce bets on his own comeback, aiming to become the oldest golfer to win a major. With coach Amanda and caddie Mitts by his side, he confronts the past that held him back.

What genre is Stick?
Stick is a feel-good sports comedy about second chances, found family and relationships.

Who are the golf guest stars and cameos in Stick Season 2?
Season two welcomes back broadcasters Jim Nantz and Trevor Immelman, alongside golf personalities Matt Scharff and Dan Rapaport.

What are other shows and movies like Stick?
If you enjoy Stick’s humor and heart, try Ted Lasso, Shrinking, Trying or Acapulco. For more golf, unlikely friendships and comeback stories, try Tin Cup, Happy Gilmore, Caddyshack or Jerry Maguire.

snippet.title: The Escapists 3 | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Escapists is back, and freedom has never required worse ideas. Plan your breakout (or wing it!), craft items, and perform the perfect escape in The Escapists 3. Arriving in 2027! 🏃‍♂️💨

*WISHLIST NOW!*
⚫ Steam: https://bit.ly/TE3-Steam  
🟢 Xbox: https://bit.ly/TE3-Xbox  
🔵 PlayStation: https://bit.ly/TE3-PS  
 
The Escapists 3 is a prison escape sandbox where you can dig, sneak, climb, fight, disguise yourself and improvise your way to freedom. Alone or with friends! 

*👮 Prison has rules, but you have other plans:* Learn the routine and watch the guards, take jobs and earn cash, swipe whatever isn’t nailed down and turn everyday junk into the beginnings of an escape plan.   

*🫵 Escape your way:* Every prison is a system waiting to be understood, exploited and very badly outsmarted. Dig beneath the walls, climb your way out or find another route entirely. And getting beyond the perimeter might only be the beginning. There’s no single solution, just good plans, bad plans and the occasional plan involving molten chocolate. 

*🪥 Rubbish can become your freedom:* Search cells, trade with inmates and complete jobs to get your hands on supplies. Almost anything can become part of an escape plan. Whether it should…that’s another question. 

*⛓️ Five Prisons with plenty of bad ideas:* Break out of five distinctive prisons, each with its own routines, characters, secrets and once you have snuck past the guards discover what waits for you beyond the walls. Lose yourself in dense forests, climb across gusty canyons, explore ancient catacombs and find your way across dangerous waters. 

*🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Better with Accomplices:* Try and escape solo or team up with friends. Play with two players in local split-screen, or take your escape online with up to four. Divide the jobs, play to each other's strengths, coordinate the timing and execute the perfect prison break… and discover which of your friends is useless with a shovel.
